scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build:react && npm run build:next
scripts.build:examples: npm run build -w @inlens/example-react-vite && npm run build -w @inlens/example-nextjs && npm run build -w nextjs-app-router-ecommerce && npm run build -w nextjs-app-router-data-magnify && npm run build -w nextjs-app-router-cache-components
scripts.typecheck: npm run build && npm run typecheck:packages
scripts.typecheck:packages: npm run typecheck -w @inlens/core && npm run typecheck -w @inlens/react && npm run typecheck -w @inlens/next
scripts.format:check:packages: oxfmt --check packages skills tests package.json package-lock.json tsconfig.base.json vitest.config.ts vitest.browser.config.ts .oxlintrc.json .oxfmtrc.json .changeset .github/workflows/ci.yml .github/workflows/release.yml README.md CONTRIBUTING.md
scripts.release: npm run build && npm run test:boundaries && changeset publish
scripts.check: npm run lint:packages && npm run format:check:packages && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:boundaries && npm run test:size
